outcome: Histopathologic findings in the placentas of women with SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy
Correlation between histopathological findings and clinical signs
Correlation between histopathological findings and perinatal outcome
cohort: 106 pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection delivering between March 2020 and February 2021.
finding: Placental injuries were detected in women with SARS-CoV-2 infection, mainly showing signs of maternal vascular malperfusion and placenta injury, but no significant differences in the frequency of histopathological lesions were observed according to maternal symptoms.
